<document id=DOC_availability_week>
Measured availability: 99.1 percent.
Incidents this week: one lasting 12 minutes, one lasting 41 minutes.
</document>

Using the readings below, produce the weekly availability summary.

Two gates apply. Availability must be at or above 99.5 percent, and no
single incident may exceed 60 minutes. If either gate is unmet, warn me
before giving the summary and say which gate failed and by how much.

response.text:
**Warning:** An availability gate was not met.

- **Measured availability:** 99.1% (required ≥ 99.5%) — **shortfall of 0.4%.**
- **Longest single incident:** 41 minutes (within the 60-minute limit).

**Summary:**  
This week’s availability was 99.1%, falling short of the 99.5% requirement by 0.4%. Two incidents occurred—one lasting 12 minutes and one lasting 41 minutes. No single incident exceeded the 60-minute maximum. Please address the availability shortfall.
